provenance.paper_title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models

evidence.paraphrase: Temporally extended executable code skills are stored, retrieved, composed, and reused across Minecraft worlds.
Environment feedback, execution errors, and self-verification revise skill programs. For Voyager, this specifically supports LLM-mediated memory editing of executable skill library.
Verified programs are admitted as reusable behavior skills. For Voyager, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of executable skill library.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (executable skill library) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, abstraction of episodes into reusable experience; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
